🌴 **MIG'S WORLD | ROAD TO VICE CITY** 🚨

**GTA VI arrives November 19, 2026** on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar lists preloading beginning **November 10**.

🎉 **Our Discord launch-eve party:** Wednesday, November 18 • **11:45 PM ET**
🎙️ Join us for the final countdown, trivia, and community discussion!

📅 RSVP: https://discord.gg/rSUVaYmUa?event=1569361550597169286
⏳ Live timer: https://migtam628.github.io/gta-vi/
📰 Official GTA VI site: https://www.rockstargames.com/VI

🇪🇸 **En español:** GTA VI llega el 19 de noviembre. ¡Nuestra fiesta comienza el 18 de noviembre a las 11:45 p. m., hora del Este! Confirma tu asistencia con el enlace del evento.

*Fan event; not affiliated with Rockstar Games.*

👋 **WELCOME TO VICE CITY CHAT! / ¡BIENVENIDOS!** 🌴

Let's get the conversation started:

🎮 Which GTA game was your very first?
🏆 What's your all-time favorite GTA memory?
🕹️ Are you playing on PS5 or Xbox Series X|S?

🇪🇸 **¡Cuéntanos!** ¿Cuál fue tu primer GTA? ¿Cuál es tu mejor recuerdo de la saga? ¿Vas a jugar en PS5 o Xbox?

Be friendly and keep storyline spoilers in #gta6-spoilers once the game releases. 💜

🔮 **GTA VI PREDICTION POLL #1 / ENCUESTA DE PREDICCIONES**

What will be the **first thing you do** when you get to explore Vice City?

🚗 Drive around and explore the map
🏖️ Head straight to the beach
🎬 Focus on Jason and Lucia's story
📸 Look for easter eggs and hidden details

🇪🇸 ¿Qué harás primero en Vice City: conducir, ir a la playa, avanzar en la historia o buscar secretos?

Reply with your choice and tell us why! These are community predictions, **not confirmed gameplay details**.

🏆 **MIG'S WORLD — GTA TRIVIA #1 / TRIVIA DE GTA**

Who is the main playable protagonist of **Grand Theft Auto: Vice City** (2002)?

**A)** Tommy Vercetti
**B)** Niko Bellic
**C)** Claude
**D)** Trevor Philips

🇪🇸 ¿Quién es el protagonista principal de *GTA: Vice City* (2002)?

Reply with **A, B, C, or D** — no searching! 😉

🎮 No prizes required; this round is just for community bragging rights.

📸 **THE GTA VI MEDIA HUB / GALERÍA DE GTA VI** 🌴

Start with official material from Rockstar:

🎬 **Launch trailer:** https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/launch-trailer
🖼️ **Official screenshots and artwork:** https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/launch-gallery
🌎 **Game hub:** https://www.rockstargames.com/VI

Share your **favorite official screenshot**, a fan-made wallpaper, your own art, or a trailer moment you can't stop watching.

🇪🇸 Comparte tu captura oficial favorita, arte creado por ti o el momento del tráiler que más te emocionó.

Please credit creators, mark fan art as fan art, and avoid leaked or pirated materials.

⚠️ **GTA VI SPOILER ZONE / ZONA DE SPOILERS** ⚠️

This channel is for story, mission, and ending discussions **after launch**.

✅ Keep plot reveals here, not in #gta6-general, #gta6-media, or #gta6-announcements.
✅ Use Discord spoiler tags for big surprises: `||your spoiler here||`.
✅ Start each post with a clear spoiler warning if it includes missions, character outcomes, or endings.
🚫 No leaked/stolen content, harassment, or spoilers disguised as usernames.

🇪🇸 Los spoilers de la historia se publican **solo aquí**. Utiliza `||etiquetas de spoiler||` para las revelaciones importantes. No compartas filtraciones.

Respect members who want to discover Vice City at their own pace. 🌴
